goal: Protect legacy wallet migrations against mid-process failures and data corruption
Ensure failed migrations automatically roll back without risking fund loss or manual repair
agreement: Support because it keeps the original wallet untouched until migration succeeds (ryanofsky)
Unaddressed objection: raw error code matching fails on MSVC under Windows (ryanofsky)
Unaddressed objection: unhandled cleanup failures can leave temporary files behind (ryanofsky)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it prevents wallet corruption and key loss during legacy wallet migration
Master deletes the original database before confirming the new database is written
Leftover journal files can also roll back into the new database and corrupt user data
